newsletter.intro: Poki worries that his spikes might hurt his friends, so he hides away. Koko listens, stays gentle, and helps him find a safe way to share a warm hug. The story gives children a simple reminder: looking different does not make anyone less worthy of friendship and care.

htmlPreview:
A calm bedtime story about friendship, self-acceptance, and three simple English words to practice together.

Koko's Forest · EP007

Poki Wants a Hug

Poki worries that his spikes might hurt his friends, so he hides away. Koko listens, stays gentle, and helps him find a safe way to share a warm hug. The story gives children a simple reminder: looking different does not make anyone less worthy of friendship and care.

Learning words

gentle
JEN-tl		 溫柔的；輕柔的
Koko found a gentle way to help Poki.
soft
SOFT		 柔軟的
They used something soft for the hug.
hug
HUG		 擁抱
Poki shared a warm hug with his friend.

Parent activity

After watching, ask your child: What can help a hug feel safe and gentle? Practice the words gentle, soft, and hug, then let your child choose a wave, high-five, or hug. 家長小提醒：先詢問孩子是否想擁抱，也可以讓孩子選擇揮手或擊掌，練習尊重彼此的感受。

Watch the story together: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sSntjdCfB-U

For more Koko parent resources and bilingual learning ideas, visit https://fursay.com/koko

Children can learn that kindness includes listening, asking, and finding a comfortable way to show care. Poki's story offers a calm way to practice those ideas before bedtime.
